pc_desc.step1: Copy the update script (copy entire text).
pc_desc.step2: If the bookmark bar is hidden, press Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) + Shift + B to show it.
pc_desc.step3: Right-click on an empty space on the bookmark bar and select 'Add Bookmark'.
pc_desc.step4: Set a name, paste the script into the URL/address field, and save.
pc_desc.step5: Go to the eAmusement Pass website and log in.
pc_desc.step6: Click the bookmark to run the script.

chrome_desc.step1: Copy the update script (excluding the letter 'j').
chrome_desc.step2: Go to the eAmusement Pass website and log in.
chrome_desc.step3: Type 'j' in the address bar, paste the script next to it, and press Enter to run.

safari_desc.step1: Copy the update script (copy entire text).
safari_desc.step2: Tap the Share menu at the bottom and select 'Add Bookmark'.
safari_desc.step3: Tap the Bookmarks icon to view your bookmark list.
safari_desc.step4: Long-press the bookmark you just added and select 'Edit'.
safari_desc.step5: Change the name, paste the script into the address field, and save.
safari_desc.step6: Log in to the eAmusement Pass website.
safari_desc.step7: Open the Bookmarks menu and tap the bookmark you just edited to run the script.

reset.title: About Data Reset
reset.desc1: If you perform this process, all data you have registered so far will be deleted and cannot be recovered.
reset.desc2t: List of data to be deleted
reset.desc2s: Titles, names, GuitarFreaks and DrumMania user data (skills, all song skills, clear counts/highest difficulty, full combo counts/highest difficulty, excellent counts/highest difficulty, play count), play data for each song (skill per song, rank, combo, play count, clear count, achievement rate, score, skill meter, old achievement rate)
reset.desc3: Your account will not be deleted, but you can disconnect your Google account from the Google Account management page.
reset.desc4: Google - My Account - Account Settings - Connected Apps & Sites - Manage Apps - Select GITADORA Info - Deselect
